label: Wind-speed ratio at 1.5 m (OpenFOAM, wind from 225 deg)
unit: ratio to the undisturbed inflow at the same height

summary.unit: open-ground cells of 2 m on the design site; ratio = |U| / undisturbed inflow at the same height

method.model: OpenFOAM v2412 simpleFoam, k-epsilon, ABL inlet (analysis/wind_noise/cfd/)
method.slice: cells cut by z = 1.5 m; on the design site 0.0-5.1 m
method.reference: the inlet log-law profile (ABLConditions) at each cut cell's centre height; checked against the measured upwind flow (inflow.profile_check)
method.map: design site + 50 m; buildings from the case's STL

limitations: One wind direction and speed; comfort classes (NEN 8100) need the KNMI wind rose.
Cells near the ground are ~5 m: the slice reads the first cell layer, so any height inside it gives the same map.
Only the design site's buildings are modelled; shelter from the wider neighbourhood is not.
